blocks.text: Young gardeners will have a bubble blast this summer as they help with yard work while creating tons of awesome bubbles! This John Deere motorized toy leaf blower is a fun way to get kids up and moving outside. With its realistic design and mechanical sounds, it helps to promote pretend play and encourages kids to use their imagination while helping out around the yard. Just squeeze and hold the trigger to create a continuous stream of bubbles. When it's time to fill up, kids can grab the John Deere Gas Can and top off their leaf blower for more bubble fun. Who said yard work had to be boring?

items: Help around the yard with your very own John Deere bubble leaf blower! Blow a continuous stream of non-stop bubbles without losing your breath.
This battery-operated toy leaf blower is a fun way to get kids up and moving, uses 3 AA batteries not included. Help encourage imagination and role play fun for awesome outdoor play.

With its realistic design and mechanical sounds, the blower helps to promote pretend play and encourages kids to use their imagination. Help teach the value of chores while engaging in tons of bubble fun.
Just squeeze and hold the easy push trigger for 30 seconds to create a continuous stream of bubbles. Watch as children have a blast with this cute bubble toy.

items.value: 44oz Bubble Refill Gas Can, John Deere Bubble Leaf Blower

items.value: Encourage imaginative play, role-playing, understanding of chores, and basic bubble science.
